title: Preserve healthchecks in OCI images
body:
Requires https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1334

#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Healthchecks are now preserved in the OCI image configuration using Docker's compatibility extension. Configuration overrides are applied consistently, and confidential-workload conversion continues to omit healthchecks, as before.

The implementation follows Docker's `Config`/`ContainerConfig` precedence: `Config` takes precedence whenever present; `ContainerConfig` is only used as a fallback when `Config` is absent.

When no healthcheck is configured, OCI config serialization remains byte-for-byte identical, ensuring existing OCI image digests remain stable.


#### How to verify it

Build an OCI image from a Containerfile containing:
```
FROM scratch
HEALTHCHECK CMD /bin/true
```
```
buildah bud --format oci -t healthcheck-oci .
buildah inspect --type=image --format '{{.Docker.Config.Healthcheck.Test}}' healthcheck-oci
```
Expected output:
```
[CMD /bin/true]
```

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Related to https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/25454 and https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/18904. The consumer-side support is provided by the required container-libs change.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Buildah now preserves Docker HEALTHCHECK configuration when building OCI images, using a Docker-compatible extension to the OCI image configuration.
```
